interpretations: For each distinct `Patient.SEX` value, including NULL as a group, average each matched patient’s examination values separately for `aCL IgG` and `ANA`; then report the mean of those patient averages for each sex and its ANA mean divided by the unweighted mean of the per-sex ANA means.

For each non-NULL `Patient.SEX` value, average each matched patient’s examination values separately for `aCL IgG` and `ANA`; then report the mean of those patient averages for each sex and its ANA mean divided by the unweighted mean of the non-NULL-sex ANA means.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS igg_average,
        AVG(e.ANA) AS ana_average
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_means AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(igg_average) AS igg_mean,
        AVG(ana_average) AS ana_mean
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    igg_mean,
    ana_mean,
    ana_mean * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(ana_mean) FROM sex_means) AS ana_mean_ratio
FROM sex_means

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.SEX,
        p.ID,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS igg_average,
        AVG(e.ANA) AS ana_average
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.SEX, p.ID
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(igg_average) AS igg_mean,
        AVG(ana_average) AS ana_mean
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    igg_mean,
    ana_mean,
    ana_mean / AVG(ana_mean) OVER () AS ana_mean_ratio
FROM sex_averages;
